summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a previously approved one-for-ten reverse stock split, now expected to become effective July 24, 2026. Stockholders approved via written consent on December 1, 2025; the company delayed filing the charter amendment from the original March 2026 timeline. The split is a routine capital structure adjustment, not part of a merger, tender offer, or other transformative event. No deal terms, premiums, or advisors are involved. The filing serves only to update the effective date and is not a special situation.
